Version A — the dedicated "＋ Add note" button right on the bookmark — feels the most natural to me. It's clearly labeled as a note, so I know exactly what it's for, and it flips to "Edit note" once I've written one. Version C's "Write a note about this bookmark…" field was inviting too and I'd be fine with it; Version B tucked the note inside the broader "Edit details" form, which is workable but mixes it in with the title and description more than I'd like for a quick jotting. So A is my pick.

Your framing is right: I'd want the saved note shown beneath its bookmark so I can see it at a glance, and having it become searchable right away is exactly what I'd expect — that's what made the earlier "fermentation" search find things. Good.
